# Meridian Marine Co. — Vendor Assignment & Communication Standard v1

## Purpose

Make every vendor assignment clear enough to reduce delays, misunderstandings, and unauthorized work.

## Assignment brief

Every material assignment should identify:

- Vessel/client
- Location/access requirements
- Requested service
- Scope and known condition
- Required completion date/time
- Owner approval status where applicable
- Budget/quote information where applicable
- MMC contact
- Required completion confirmation

## Communication rules

- Use approved MMC communication channels.
- Keep material scope changes in writing where practical.
- Confirm schedule changes promptly.
- Require vendors to report unexpected conditions before expanding scope where practical.
- Do not send unnecessary owner information.
- Never represent unverified vendor claims as confirmed facts.

## Completion confirmation

The vendor should provide appropriate confirmation of:

- Work completed
- Work not completed
- New issues discovered
- Materials/parts used where relevant
- Final or updated cost
- Recommended follow-up

## Disputes

Material disputes should be documented and escalated to MMC management rather than argued informally through field personnel.
